props.gloss_en: R' Yehuda in the mishna: we have found a small name from a large name -- Shem from Shimon and from Shmuel, Noach from Nachor, Dan from Daniel, Gad from Gaddiel
the stam's reading of R' Yehuda: it is two letters that are two names [different letters] he obligates; two letters that are one name [the same letter] he does not
(entertained) one might think: not [liable] until he writes the whole name, weaves the whole garment, makes the whole sieve
the verse says 'from one' (Lev 4:2) -- [part of the labour suffices]
(entertained) if 'from one', one might think: even if he wrote only one letter, wove only one thread, made only one mesh of the sieve
the verse says 'one' (Lev 4:22) -- [a single letter is not a labour]
the tanna kamma: how so? he is not liable until he writes a small name from a large name -- Shem from Shimon and Shmuel, Noach from Nachor, Dan from Daniel, Gad from Gaddiel
even if he wrote only two letters that are one name [the same letter twice] -- liable, e.g. shesh, tet, rar, gag, chach (R' Yehuda in the baraita, 103b.1; R' Yehuda in Rabban Gamliel's name, 103b.5)
R' Yosei: is he liable on account of writing? he is liable only on account of marking
R' Yosei: for they would mark the boards of the Tabernacle to know which was its pair
R' Yosei: therefore one who made one scratch across two boards, or two scratches on one board, is liable
R' Shimon: how so? he is not liable until he does a labour of which the like endures
R' Yosei: 'and does one', 'and does these' -- sometimes one is liable once for all of them, and sometimes for each one
the stam: no difficulty -- this [the mishna's] is his own, that [the baraita's] is his teacher's
(entertained) R' Shimon's position is the same as the first tanna's
(entertained) and if you say: the difference between them is alef-alef of a'azercha (Isa 45:5)
(entertained) one who writes alef-alef of a'azercha is liable -- the tanna kamma would hold not, R' Shimon would hold liable
(entertained, for R' Shimon) since it occurs in amulets generally, he is liable
the baraita: one who drills any amount is liable
the baraita: one who scrapes any amount [is liable]
the baraita: one who tans any amount [is liable]
the baraita: one who draws a form on a vessel, any amount [is liable]
the stam: rather, R' Shimon comes to teach us this: [not liable] until he writes the whole name
the stam: emend and read thus [R' Shimon's baraita]: one might think, not until he writes the whole verse -- the verse says 'from one'
R' Yosei b. R' Chanina: R' Yosei's reason -- 'one'/'from one', 'these'/'from these': one that is these, and these that are one
'one' is [writing the whole name] Shimon
'from one' is [writing] Shem out of Shimon
'these' are the primary labours
'from these' are the derivative labours
'one that is these' is knowing it is Shabbat and unwitting of the labours
'these that are one' is unwitting that it is Shabbat while knowing the labours
